g.title: course_stack
g.text: (every Course gets this isolated set of resources)

g.title: content_pipeline
g.text: (git-versioned content -> validated -> live in every scoped Course)
Invariant: green pipeline <=> that sha is live exactly where it scopes; red <=> nothing of it shipped

g.title: rehearse
g.text: writes prefixed copies to test Course

g.title: data_observability
g.text: (backups, interim safety net, metrics and logs)

g.title: retention
g.text: - CNPG backups are the primary recovery path.
- Interim dump exists only while the S3 store is degraded.
- Removing a Course stops pruning: the last State DB backup persists (semester-end archive).
